integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard lattice-generation description and uses no numerical experiment as proof. The focal arXiv full text was inspected; broader older comparators were compared to the extent explicitly described in the review and audit.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the canonical Fremlin tensor C([0,1]) bar-tensor C([0,1]) and kernels real-analytic on the full connected interior.
No classification is asserted for merely smooth nonanalytic kernels, no minimal-rank estimate is proved, and no completed projective tensor norm is analyzed.
An older equivalent formulation under decomposition/approximation terminology remains a residual literature risk because complete text was not available for every comparator.
title: Analytic kernels in the Fremlin tensor of C([0,1]) have finite separation rank
